title: Conditional κ=0.0011208649522582786: split centres with complete signed admission
body:
This adds complete signed bit admission and refined finite accounting to the two actual constructions in pinned PR433. The resulting **conditional κ is `44834598090331144184841 / (40 × 10²⁴) ≈ 0.0011208649522582786`**. The numerical improvement over the pinned native value is only `24184841 / (40 × 10²⁴)`, approximately `6.04621025 × 10^-19`; the substantive addition is fresh signed-decoder, geometry, primitive-cost and complete-prefix evidence. This is not a new split-centre construction or a highest-current-score claim.

The additive package is `research/e8-split-centres-signed-composition`. Its complex bound is `1183986549206329246771 / 10²⁴`; its bit bound is `561061350132569610283 / (500 × 10²¹)`. **The bit supplier binds.** The final value is recomputed from the two actual emitted programs, without adding independently reported gains.

### Construction and attribution

**icekylinx, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, supplies the split-centre Hamming construction, reversible source-centre bit construction, integration and checks in [PR433](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/433), pinned at `6d9244518175caf9e0089f92486959bc2c317273`. **Zhihao Chen, with OpenAI Codex assistance**, supplies PR425's mutable-basis Hamming/common-frame interface and PR386's compressed bit geometry, owner template and accounting. **ai-nanachi, with OpenAI Codex assistance**, supplies the unchanged PR426 R767 word used before the source-centre replacements. Original notices credit its 55 clean-reset helper reuses and 54 frame changes.

Dylan Crow's PR370 bit producer, with Anthropic Claude assistance; Jacob Sussman's E8 family and interchange framework; **eumemic / PR388's signed defining-decoder and complete-prefix work**; and all further inherited contributions retain their original notices. Our package adds source-bound signed admission, fresh compressed geometry, an independent literal complex-primitive audit, corrected signed costs and refined exact arithmetic. It does not claim the two underlying constructions as ours.

The native carrier restores **58 exact Git files**: complete 47-file PR433 and 11-file PR386 source packages, including original manifests, licenses and notices. The only existing published dependency is the frozen ten-file `e8-bit-signed-validation` package. Its relevant signed-source module is adapted explicitly; its unrelated full ancestor chain is not rerun. No previous published tree is edited.

### Fresh finite evidence

The default runs the **unchanged PR433 entry point with `--replay-phases`**, so every selected phase pair is freshly regenerated. It then checks:

- The complex word's **800 scalar columns**, arbitrary dirt, common-frame labels and private cleanup in both orientations; **2918 exact Gaussian phase pairs and 240 endpoint adapters**; eight global coordinate columns, owners, padding and complete invoice. Eight rank-eight and eight rank-one copies replace the earlier centres. The word has **560 helpers**, width **73**, **12,720 live / 13,298 physical slots**, **40,320 helper placements** and rank mass **926,064**.
- An independent interpreter of the serialized complex programs, importing neither the producer nor scalar emitter: **222,204 forward and 222,300 backward real primitive operations**, including **29,252 HALF operations per orientation**. All live endpoints and private zeros pass, and omitting an actual HALF is rejected in each orientation. Primitive costs equal the native paid bill.
- The bit word's **998 local scalar columns**, defining signed integer decoder, literal parity projection, arbitrary helper dirt and chronological signed inverse. Nine retained forms are computed in mutable source rows using **559 basis shears**, then undone after the sequential copies. The complete nine-stage scalar schedule and **7782 columns per replica** are replayed, alongside the emitted template's frame, owner and bank audit.
- **Fresh PR386 geometry**, with **1080 route checks, 240 exact endpoint checks and 121 adverse controls**, matching all mathematical fields of the inherited geometry. The original carried geometry receipt is retained as provenance and is not labeled a fresh regeneration. The bit template has **758 helpers**, width **64**, **eight replicas**, **14,502 live / 14,511 physical slots** and rank mass **925,632**.

The defining decoder satisfies the required integer construction and parity projection; the unsigned XOR word is not presented as an integer-identity certificate. The signed correction needs **8537 weighted additions, including 245 even coefficients**, or **8978 signed unit additions** versus **8292 parity units**. The extra **686 units per local invocation**, totaling **49,392 over 72 invocations**, are charged in the final invoice. The corrected local prefix majorants are **3,885,147 forward and 15,348,968 inverse**. Their counted global majorant and finite coefficient need **223 bits**, within **256**; the two-level coefficient needs **483 bits**, within **512**.

Both suppliers retain rank deficit **2496** and strict degree-two halving. Bit and complex row coefficients **18,355** and **15,445** fit the retained **20,161** reserve. Two rational moment engines include overhead and exclude adjacent root-grid points. The corrected finite coefficient feeds **eight explicit charged continuations and all 47 strict outer inequalities**, with `eta=beta=10^-30` and counted common outer `log2` threshold `14 × 10³⁰`. The adjacent final grid point and complex leaf cap are rejected.

### Scope and reproducibility

All-size weighted compilation and compressed windows, arbitrary correlated-bank substitution, ordinary calls, common prime/chart/precision/tape interfaces, restored rows, setup/recovery, analytic transfer and a dominating stage-specific `C_full` remain conditional. The generalized mutable-source/common-frame proof is the upstream interface; this is not acceptance by older restricted gx/gxcore checks, a Lean proof, an unconditional multiplication theorem or a practical runtime estimate.

The portable verifier validates source inventories before and after replay. `VALIDATION.json` must equal the frozen `EXPECTED.json` exactly. Complete decoded templates, schedules, operators, owners, profiles, costs, inequalities and adverse-control outcomes remain bound. Only named clocks, fresh provenance and compressed cross-hashes are projected or rebound; raw receipts preserve the full provenance. PR433 already binds phase evidence by decoded payload, so this package uses **no gzip-header hook and no native-source mutation**. Independent carrier review compared all 58 Git files and exercised 29 malformed transport controls.

```sh
python -m pip install -r research/e8-split-centres-signed-composition/requirements.txt
python -B research/e8-split-centres-signed-composition/verify.py /absolute/path/to/new-output
```

The workflow runs this full default on **Python 3.12 and 3.13** with pinned SymPy 1.14.0 and mpmath 1.3.0, preserving replay evidence. Native PR433 itself uses the standard library; the extra fresh geometry requires those dependencies. This adds **21 package files and one workflow**. All **22 previously published research trees**, including the three inventory-specific padding appendices, remain byte-identical.
